top_choice_rationale: P001 rests on one testable chemical idea, a small molecule inducing proximity between a target and an E3 ligase so that the cell removes the protein catalytically. It has been reproduced independently for over two decades, and the cereblon finding resolved how thalidomide acts. Crews and Deshaies (heterobifunctional degraders) and Handa (cereblon) cover both strands at their origin. The omission of Sakamoto, Ciulli, Gray, Ito and Kim and the lack of an approved bifunctional degrader are real costs but smaller than the novelty and reach of the concept. P002 (Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling) is the mature, cleanly allocated fallback, and P003 follows with base editing, whose priority and CRISPR-prize overlap are less settled.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; his field (nucleotide metabolism, RNR regulation by ubiquitin-dependent turnover) is adjacent to but not a direct stake in any proposal
